subject.title: [Bug]: sessions_yield subagent wake can compact parent branch at low context usage

question: Should successful-turn overflow compaction be allowed to trust raw `input + cacheRead` when no `contextUsage` snapshot exists, and should persisted compaction entries gain a closed trigger reason for parent-wake decisions?
rationale: The remaining fix crosses overflow safety for providers that intentionally rely on usage-based silent-overflow detection and a persisted transcript metadata contract, so automation should not choose the permanent policy alone.

options.title: Require trusted context usage
options.body: Use `contextUsage`, last-call usage, or finite/provider-approved fallbacks for successful-turn overflow decisions, and add trigger metadata with focused migration-safe tests.

options.title: Treat #99864 as sufficient for now
options.body: Close the low-context false-compaction lane only for Anthropic cached usage and defer OpenAI-compatible/provider-independent evidence to a new or related issue.

options.title: Split attribution from the bug fix
options.body: Fix the false-compaction predicate first and track trigger metadata as a separate maintainer-owned observability change.

recommendation.title: Require trusted context usage
recommendation.body: Use `contextUsage`, last-call usage, or finite/provider-approved fallbacks for successful-turn overflow decisions, and add trigger metadata with focused migration-safe tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision involves compaction safety semantics, provider-neutral session accounting, and persisted transcript metadata where recent history points to steipete for product-direction routing.
